1.

All these three petitions, being connected petitions, filed by the same petitioner, have been taken
up together.
2.  There are three separate FIRs against the petitioner herein.
These are filed for commission of offences under Section 376 IPC, Section 498A IPC and Section 313 IPC, respectively.
3. Quashing is being sought as all the matters have been amicably settled.
4. Respondent No.2 is present in Court but seeks adjournment as her counsel is not available today.
